notes.title: Enter the Park on macOS and Linux!
notes.content:
Penko Park visitors!
It is with great pleasure that we can announce:

Penko Park is now opening its gates for macOS and Linux players!

- The Mac binaries support both Intel and Apple Silicon-based Macs, so it should work on most Macs.
- The Linux binaries have been tested on Debian Linux, but they should work on Ubuntu as well.

Please post any bugs or issues you come across in the Steam community forums.

🎉 To celebrate the release on those new platforms, the game is 50% off for the next 7 days: Please support us by buying the game for yourself or a very dear friend! 🎉


Enjoy your stay in Penko Park!

Follow us on
Twitter
Instagram
... for more updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/852090/Penko_Park/

notes.title: Penko Park Out Now on Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
Hey Penkis!
The portable park gates are open; Penko Park is out now on Nintendo Switch! 

This new release on Nintendo Switch offers the full Penko Park experience, including The Shivering Crypts expansion, which added a new park region, 40 new monsters, plus additional features, collectibles, and secrets on top of the original game.

Please enjoy the Nintendo Switch launch trailer below

[previewyoutube=Bsgdc6tSD78;full][/previewyoutube]

Purchase Penko Park on the Nintendo eShop!

notes.title: Penko Park announced for Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
Hey Penkis!
We’re incredibly excited to announce that Penko Park, the creepy-cute on-rails adventure where you embark on an eekological survey through an eerie abandoned wildlife park, is bound for Nintendo Switch™; releasing on 27 September, 2022.  

The upcoming Nintendo Switch release contains the full Penko Park experience, including The Shivering Crypts expansion, which added a new park region, 40 new monsters, plus additional features, collectibles, and secrets on top of the original game.

Penko Park for Nintendo Switch is available to wishlist on your console today!

Happy Holidays everyone!

notes.title: The Shivering Crypts
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Penkos!

The Shivering Crypts expansion is finally here and free to all Penko Park owners!

As a reminder, the expansion adds a huge amount of new content:

 A whole new level for you to explore (and the largest one yet!)	
 More than 40 new monsters (making a total of 143!)
 A new and mysterious tool
 New outfits & collectibles
 New secrets
 Full Gamepad support
 Many new localized languages including Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
 Bug fixes and performance improvements
 …and more!

Penko Park is 20% off in Steam’s Daily Deal from September 7th, 2021 10:00 PDT / 18:00 BST / 19:00 CEST to September 10th, 2021 10:00 PDT/ 18:00 BST / 19:00 CEST.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/852090/Penko_Park/

With this free major update, there has never been a better time to take a trip to Penko Park! Who knows what you might see?

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Speedrun Timer and Bugfixes
notes.content:
Changelog:


Added Speedrun Timer for Any % and 100 % runs. Can be selected from Options -> Controls.
Changed "Delete All Savegame Files" behaviour to only delete gameplay progress, not user configs like controls, keybinds, resolution etc.
Fixed gamebreaking bug that occurred when placing photo during leveling up (you had to be VERY fast for that to happen) and caused you to get an additional unplaceable Penko Stamp.
Fixed gamebreaking bug that occurred when going back to album via menu while the game was already loading the album.
Fixed bug that happened when [spoiler]the player took a photo of Erlpenki before the final Penki dialog.[/spoiler]
Fixed small typos.
Fixed various other tiny bugs.
Added Community Discord button in main menu.
Added version number in main menu.


If you have an interest in speedrunning, join our Discord!
We have a small, friendly speedrunning community and are very excited to see new world records! :)

Join our Discord!

We have some exciting news regarding Penko Park lined up for the coming year, so stay tuned for that!
Happy holidays & stay healthy!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Russian Localization and small fixes
notes.content:
Добро пожаловать в Парк Пенко™!
We just added russian localization to the game!

Other languages are coming soon, too:
We are close to finishing up localization for Spanish, Portuguese and Japanese.
If you are fluent in Chinese or Italian and would like to help us translate, please send a mail to mail@ghostbutter.com or DM me @ghostbutter on Twitter.

Other fixes:
- Many small fixes to the levels & terrains.
- Some minor balance tweaks

Upcoming patches will include Mac/Linux support, performance improvements, fixes for crashes and more languages!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Penki will now respect your choice of hat when talking to you.
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.2 is done!

Please let us know of any gamebreaking bugs, glitches etc. - either by writing on the Steam Forums or a mail to support [ a t ] ghostbutter [ d o t ] com


 Penki will now respect your choice of hat when talking to you (Wears your chosen hat in dialogs).
 Levers that already unlocked a path become non-interactable on subsequent runs.
 Fixed some problems with the grappler behaviour.
 Fixed a small UI issue with the Kart Stop Timer
 Slight rebalancing of some of the mechanics
 Fixed some small typos and other glitches

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Inverted Mouse & Bugfixes
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 is here! We added an inverted mouse option and fixed some small things!

Please let us know of any gamebreaking bugs, glitches etc. - either by writing on the Steam Forums or a mail to support [ a t ] ghostbutter [ d o t ] com


 Added an "Invert Mouse Look" option
 Fixed some typos
 Added a small delay that prevents absurdly fast tool switching with the mouse wheel
 Fixed some achievements
 Fixed the kart stop system not properly pausing

notes.title: The park gates are open! Come on in!
notes.content:
Hello fellow park explorers!

We are glad to finally open the gates of Penko Park to the general public, once more!
We hope you enjoy your stay and have safe trips throug the park.
Please listen to Penki for any and all safety instructions!

In any case, we are very glad to welcome you as our first new guests after the shutdown of 1957.

On semi-related notes:

We are working on the first patch that will kink out some bugs that could not be contained before release.
Things we will definitely add:
- Inverted Mouse Support

If there's anything else you would want as a feature/technical thing to fix or bug you encountered - please let us know: support@ghostbutter.com
